title: BLFReviewerConsentRecord
description: Schema for private machine-readable consent records authorizing participation in BLF human evaluation pilots.

session_id.description: Blinded review session identifier associated with this consent.

information_sheet_version.description: Version of docs/reviewer-consent-and-ethics.md presented to the reviewer.

consent_confirmed.description: Whether the reviewer explicitly confirmed informed consent.

consent_confirmed_at.description: ISO UTC timestamp when consent was confirmed.

consent_to_anonymized_research_use.description: Consent for anonymized judgments to be used for internal scientific research and model evaluation.

consent_to_anonymized_public_release.description: Consent for anonymized aggregate judgments to be included in public open scientific dataset releases.

withdrawal_status.description: Current status of consent. If WITHDRAWN, data cannot be processed.
